change: Correlate statically known SQL and parameter variants by conditional branch before reporting location-scope evidence.
regressions: A location predicate in one branch is not paired with a location bind from another branch.
A predicate present only in the no-location branch does not count as farm scope.
The matching location SQL and parameter branch remains classified as conditionally scoped.
limitations: The AST inventory is a source-review signal, not an authorization or tenant-isolation proof.
Dynamic SQL, helper behavior, query semantics, and runtime data remain outside this check.
Populated report-output parity and MAN-CAP-066 owner acceptance remain open.
